question: How much of the apparent long route to the southern MACS1931 halo was caused by the parent pipeline's 300 kpc member aperture?
selection_history: The published file was found to contain 120 members to 434.52 kpc after the balanced/capacity inverse; this is a spent aperture sensitivity, not fresh validation.
limits: The aperture series was motivated by inspecting the spent MACS1931 inverse.
The member catalog itself stops at about 435 kpc and still does not reach the median southern halo at about 683 kpc radius.
The halo target is model-dependent and comes from the same lens observations.
This diagnoses source-catalog truncation; it cannot promote a gravity law.
